credential: No certificate can currently be earned: the edX session is archived, so graded completion and Verified upgrade are unavailable
academic_credits: No public academic credit verified for independent learners
scope_notes: Approximately 32-hour eight-unit beginner European-Portuguese course from the University of Porto, using a narrative journey through Porto to teach everyday communication, pronunciation, basic vocabulary, grammar and cultural context for learners starting from zero.
required_resources: Modern browser and access to the archived edX materials. edX warns that archived courses may have non-working assignments or links and do not provide an active graded/certificate route.

component_evidence.pedagogy: The course uses an eight-episode narrative set in Porto to anchor language functions in realistic everyday situations, combining linguistic form with cultural context rather than presenting isolated vocabulary lists.
component_evidence.depth: Thirty-two hours provide a serious A1-oriented introduction and more substance than a travel phrasebook, but it remains a single beginner course rather than a multi-level progression such as Nicos Weg A1-B1.
component_evidence.practice: The original design includes per-unit quizzes and comprehension/production activities, but the current edX session is archived: graded assignments no longer update and some activities or links may fail. Useful practice remains, but the live completion path has ended.
component_evidence.materials: Professional audiovisual production, narrative episodes, language/culture integration and a coherent eight-unit itinerary create an unusually polished resource for European Portuguese.
component_evidence.currency: The linguistic content remains stable and pedagogically useful, but both NAU's current provider catalogue and the learner-facing edX page identify this edition as archived. It is therefore no longer a current active course experience.
component_evidence.expertise: The course was produced by Universidade do Porto's Faculdade de Letras and educational-innovation team with professional actors and language-teaching expertise, a strong fit for an A1 LMOOC.
component_evidence.accessibility: No prior Portuguese knowledge is required and the European-Portuguese focus remains valuable. Archived edX access still exposes course materials where available, but learners cannot earn a certificate and some assignments or links may no longer work.

recommendation_rationale: Still one of the strongest freely accessible European-Portuguese beginner teaching packages found, but it is now an archived resource rather than an active course. The unique target-language value justifies retention in the canonical set, while the ended graded/certificate route and possible archive breakage materially reduce current recommendation strength.
